title: AIsa Community Skill Submission (registry metadata)
description: Registry-only metadata. The skill's identity (name, description) is read from the SKILL.md frontmatter (https://www.skillsdirectory.com/docs/skill-md-format). The registry never requires optional frontmatter fields — anything it needs beyond name/description lives here, so upstream SKILL.md files drop in unchanged.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Must match the folder name under skills/ and the frontmatter name.

github.description: GitHub username (no @) — used for attribution and prize delivery.

version.description: Registry version of this skill — bump on code changes. If the frontmatter also sets a version, the two must match.

license.description: Required OSI license (code is vendored into this repo).

repo_url.description: Upstream repository, if the skill is also maintained elsewhere.

requirements.description: External requirements: API keys, accounts, system dependencies. Empty/omitted = none.

competition.description: Set to a competition cycle (e.g. 2026-09) to enter that competition.
